decls.name: QSquaredClearsConjQuotient

paper_span.quote: Since $Q\mathcal{O}_K$ has valuation $1$ at each such prime, $Q^2u_\varepsilon\in\mathcal{O}_K$. So $u_\varepsilon\in Q^{-2}\mathcal{O}_K$.

decls.rationale: Proves the integrality step: all poles of \(u_\varepsilon\) have order \(\le 2\) and lie above the \(q_b\), so \(Q^2 u_\varepsilon \in \mathcal{O}_K\), i.e. \(u_\varepsilon \in Q^{-2}\mathcal{O}_K\).
